annotations.title: List your alert rules and delivery targets

description: The alert rules your API key created, the account's delivery targets (signing secrets are never shown) and the most recent deliveries with their status, so you can see whether a webhook is working. Only a key's own rules can be changed, deleted or tested; with `all` the account's other rules (made on the website or by other keys) are listed too, read-only (`own: false`), wallet addresses cut to a prefix and without their targets. Needs an API key.

all.description: Also list the account's other rules, read-only and redacted.

deliveries.description: How many recent deliveries to include (0-20, default 5).

name: list_alerts
title: List your alert rules and delivery targets
